independence.scenario_input: Frozen sheet and tree only. Examiner and Challenger independently create expectations from leaves.
independence.reader_input: Frozen sheet, tree and id/text scenarios only. Tools, MCP, hooks, slash commands and auto-memory disabled.
independence.control_input: Program-generated copy with selected leaf and rule paraphrases removed, plus same id/text scenarios.
independence.non_input: Reader processes cannot access expectations, working record, logs or author notes. Frozen original artifacts are immutable throughout the exam.
